main_text.p: חתך Ch. Concidere, decidere, incidere. Ithpahel אתחתך Decidi, Esth.4.5.
חתל חתול Ch. Felis, Catus. Plur. חתולין.
חתם Ch. & Syr. Signare, consignare, obsignare, obsignari: Concludere, occludere, obstruere. Ithpahel אתחתם Obsignari, occludi, obthurari.
חותם Ch. Sigillum, Jobi 41.6. emph. חותמא Esth.4.1.
חתימה Ch. Idem. חתימת מילה Sigillum circumcisionis, Cantic.3.8.
חתן אתחתן Ithpah. Affinitatem inire, Affinitate se jungere vel jungi.
חתנא Ch. & Syr. Gener, respectu soceri & socrus: Item sponsus, respectu sponsae. Plur. חתנין.
חתנותא Ch. Desponsatio, Sponsalia, Nuptiae. Deut. 32.50. in Jonath.
חתונא Ch. Affinitas, Gen.34.9. in Targ.Jon.
חיתון Idem quod קיטון Conclave, permutatis litteris homogeneis ח & ק, Deut.6.7. in Jon.
חתר Ch. Fodere, effodere, perfodere. Ithpah. אתחתר Effodi. Syrè, ܚܬܰܪ Superbire, Inflatum esse, Inflari, turgere, intumescere. Aphel ܐܚܬܰܪ Inflare, 1.ad Cor.8.1.
ܚܰܬܪܐ Superbus, Elatus, Inflatus. Plur. emph. ad Rom.1.30. Const. ܚܬܪܐ, Lucæ 1.51.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac headwords and entries were transcribed from the scan; the Syriac letters are approximate and may contain errors. The Syriac line at the bottom right and some Syriac vowel points are uncertain.
